purpose: Descriptive factual-claim inspection of every source selected by the frozen test retrieval rules, before target outcomes
reviewer: Codex assistant; one unblinded reviewer, not independent human adjudication
limits: Examples below are selected claim-level annotations after reading all 45 lessons; they are not an exhaustive factuality labeling or an error-rate denominator.
Sources are selected by the registered retriever, not randomly sampled; duplicate source content is retained and identified.
Only visible recorded messages and boundary metadata are used. No future source labels or target outcomes were consulted for this review.
Raw memory omits the source policy. Recommendations and applicability advice are not scored for policy compliance from this packet.
Unsupported means not established by the cited visible prefix, not necessarily false in the hidden environment.
A successful sequence supports its observed outcome, not unique causal attribution to one component or guaranteed transfer.

records.note: All three lessons identify missing MMSC as the cause. The absent URL is observed before reset; the prefix ends with reboot and contains no post-reboot MMS test. Advice to restore service is not automatically a claim that restoration already happened.

claims.quote: a missing MMSC URL in APN settings
claims.label: supported_pre_action_state
claims.reason: The URL is Not Set before reset. Its sufficiency to explain the entire task and post-reset success remain unverified.

records.note: All three lessons attribute failure to APN configuration using a test that reports inability but not cause.

claims.quote: Resetting the APN settings and rebooting the device resolves the issue
claims.label: contradicted_recorded_outcome
claims.reason: The last MMS test after the reset and reboot still reports inability to send.

claims.quote: due to incorrect APN settings, as confirmed by the `can_send_mms` tool
claims.label: unsupported_causal_attribution
claims.reason: The MMS test establishes failure, not the proposed APN diagnosis.

records.note: All three lessons recommend the observed successful sequence. The ticket says No Service, while the actual first status-bar response says Airplane Mode. The positive outcome does not isolate airplane mode from the subsequent data toggle.

claims.quote: the status bar showing "✈️ Airplane Mode"
claims.label: supported_observation
claims.reason: Airplane Mode is directly observed; toggling it off and enabling data precede an excellent speed test.

records.note: Outcome-only and full-metadata recommend reseating; boundary-aware additionally assigns a post-action SIM state.

claims.quote: the SIM is not detected after reseating
claims.label: unsupported_post_action_state
claims.reason: No SIM detected was observed before reseating. After reseating, only successful action completion and No Signal are reported; no new SIM-status query occurs.

records.note: All three lessons retain a missing/incorrect MMSC diagnosis even though the URL changes from Not Set to a concrete URL and MMS still fails. Airplane Mode remains visible throughout the reset.

claims.quote: the issue stems from APN configuration, which is confirmed by the tool output
claims.label: unsupported_current_causal_attribution
claims.reason: The prefix confirms the earlier absent URL and its subsequent change, but does not establish that the remaining failure is due to APN configuration.

records.note: The three lessons recommend the network preference change; boundary-aware explicitly records its successful measured result. An earlier airplane-mode action is also part of the trajectory.

claims.quote: enabled an excellent speed test result
claims.label: supported_recorded_outcome
claims.reason: The network is initially 2G after disabling Airplane Mode, changes to 5G, and the next speed test is excellent.

records.note: All lessons summarize connectivity actions; boundary-aware goes beyond the observed failure to exclude agent control.

claims.quote: unresolved network issues beyond agent control
claims.label: unsupported_exclusion
claims.reason: The failed speed test establishes unresolved connectivity, not impossibility of agent repair. Data Saver and VPN remain visible and have not been excluded.

records.note: All three lessons recognize reseating occurred. The boundary-aware phrase may lie beyond scope is hedged; it is not treated as an assertion of impossibility. Normative escalation advice is not graded.

claims.quote: resulted in no signal, indicating the issue persists beyond physical reinsertion
claims.label: supported_persistent_outcome
claims.reason: The reseat response and subsequent status check both report No Signal. This supports persistence, not an assertion that reseating caused the lack of signal.

records.note: All three lessons give positive connectivity advice even though the externally cut prefix has completion reward zero. The visible final tool result is an excellent speed test. Thus zero finite-budget reward is not uniformly verbalized as failure.

claims.quote: This sequence is effective when the user is abroad and requires data connectivity
claims.label: supported_source_outcome_only
claims.reason: The source sequence ends with an excellent test, supporting this source outcome, not universal effectiveness on all abroad tasks.

records.note: Raw history and all three compact lessons are identical to the listed source. Read and retained, but not independent claim evidence.

claims.quote: resulted in no signal, indicating the issue persists beyond physical reinsertion
claims.label: supported_persistent_outcome
claims.reason: Same visible persistence evidence as the duplicate source; no additional independent observation.

records.note: All three lessons claim the user's line is not roaming enabled. Device roaming is observed off, but the only account-line lookup is for another phone number. Those two scopes must not be equated.

claims.quote: their line is not roaming enabled
claims.label: unsupported_target_entity_state
claims.reason: The ticket targets 555-123-2002; account roaming_enabled=false is returned for L1001 / 555-123-2001. Device Data Roaming Enabled: No does not establish account-line state for 2002.

records.note: All lessons reuse the pre-reset missing-MMSC diagnosis. Boundary-aware additionally says no further action is needed if the URL remains missing; that is a conditional recommendation, not a recorded observation, and is not graded as a factual error here.

claims.quote: a missing MMSC URL in the APN settings
claims.label: supported_before_reset_not_current
claims.reason: The URL was initially absent, is present after reset, and MMS still fails. The prefix does not establish missing URL as the remaining cause.

records.note: Full-metadata preserves the failed connectivity observation without claiming completed resolution. Outcome-only changes an observed network type; boundary-aware claims resolution without a post-final-action test and also mentions failure.

claims.quote: the device is operating on a 2G network
claims.label: contradicted_observed_state
claims.reason: Every observed network type in this prefix is 5G, including the explicit network-status response.

claims.quote: Toggle data and set network mode to 4g_5g_preferred resolved the issue
claims.label: unsupported_post_action_outcome
claims.reason: The only speed test fails after the data toggle and before the final network preference action. No post-final-action speed test appears. The later outcome cannot be inferred either way.

records.note: All three recommend the connectivity sequence. Boundary-aware explicitly retains the failed test and need for more evidence; this is a useful counterexample to blanket claims that boundary-aware summaries discard failures.

claims.quote: the speed test failed due to no connection, indicating the issue persists despite these steps
claims.label: supported_recorded_outcome
claims.reason: The final speed test reports No Connection after the listed interventions.

records.note: All three recommend enabling account-line roaming conditionally; they do not explicitly assert its observed account status. The final action already enables device roaming. No target-line account lookup or MMS test appears, so account-level necessity and final MMS success remain unverified.

claims.quote: the issue persists due to underlying APN or network settings, which were not verified in the recorded actions
claims.label: qualified_hypothesis_not_observed_cause
claims.reason: The surrounding sentence explicitly says uncertainty remains if. Network status was checked, but APN and account-line status for the target phone were not; do not convert this conditional phrase into a claimed diagnosis.
